name: list_devices
description: Lists devices for a given enterprise. Requires the enterprise ID in the parent field (e.g., enterprises/{enterpriseId}).

parameters.description: Request to list devices for a given enterprise.

pageSize.description: The requested page size. If unspecified, at most 10 devices will be returned. The maximum value is 100; values above 100 will be coerced to 100. The limits can change over time.

pageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results returned by the server.

parent.description: The name of the enterprise in the form `enterprises/{enterpriseId}`.
